response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with relevant exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. While his direct GenAI production experience is limited, his technical leadership, cloud platform familiarity, and open-source contributions suggest potential to grow into the role with targeted mentorship.
strengths: Proven technical leadership and mentorship across diverse engineering teams and projects.
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq.
Extensive cloud and full-stack development background, including AWS and Kubernetes.
concerns: Lacks explicit 8+ years of dedicated AI/GenAI production experience as required.
No direct mention of vector databases or RAG architectures in resume highlights.
Limited evidence of designing evaluation pipelines or observability frameworks for AI systems.
